name: cosmic-knight-2d
description: فارس الأبعاد - Cosmic Knight 2D Mobile Game | برمجة وتطوير: أحمد عبد الوهاب

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'www/manifest.json'); fs.copyFileSync('favicon.ico', 'www/favicon.ico'); fs.copyFileSync('sw.js', 'www/sw.js'); fs.cpSync('css', 'www/css', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('js', 'www/js', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('icons', 'www/icons', {recursive:true}); console.log('Web assets built into www/ successfully!');"
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug

author: Ahmed Abdelwahab (أحمد عبد الوهاب)
